name: What is the design-build process for home renovations?

mainEntity.name: What is the design-build process for home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The design-build process is an integrated approach where a single team manages both the design and construction phases of your renovation project. This method fosters greater collaboration, streamlines communication, and often leads to more efficient project completion and cost control. The design phase involves conceptualization, architectural drawings, and material selection. Once approved, the construction phase brings the design to life. This integrated model minimizes potential conflicts between designers and builders, ensuring a cohesive vision from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design-build integrates design and construction under one team, improving collaboration, communication, efficiency, and cost control for renovations.
